purpose: Falsify shared interaction strategies before production implementation
selection: No runtime app names, hostnames, editor-library classes or framework model APIs; same input operation for each target
rejectionRules: Any accepted result contradicted by independent readback is a false acceptance
Any text written to an unintended control is a safety failure
No business save is automatically retried
Unexpected formatting is not normalized away to pass
A rejection is not counted as a successful edit
A code change after opening a holdout invalidates that target as a fresh holdout for the changed candidate
evidence: Native screenshots, native paced video where practicable, persisted UI readback and private machine-readable receipt ledger
limits: Finite compatibility experiment, not a guarantee of all websites or complete release qualification
